title: Pay taxes with cash | Internal Revenue Service
text: Skip to main content Pay taxes with cash English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In Pay Bank account (Direct Pay) Debit or credit card Your online account Business tax payment (EFTPS) Payment plan Tax debt help Penalties Interest Tax withholding Foreign electronic payments User fees Pay online It’s fast, secure and timely. The IRS requests that whenever possible, you make a payment online . You can pay by cash in person. Or mail a money order or cashier’s check purchased with cash. Pay in person IRS Taxpayer Assistance Center Make an appointment at a local assistance center. Free No dollar limit Make appointment 30-60 days before due date Pay at a Taxpayer Assistance Center Participating retailer Pay at a retailer near you. Up to $1.50 fee per payment $500 limit per payment Pay 7 days before the due date Pay at a participating retailer Pay by money order or cashier’s check Use cash to purchase a money order or cashier’s check at a grocery store, bank or U.S. post office . Then mail the money order or check to us.
